target_only_tests.note: Target-only tests translate no source case and are NOT counted as ported coverage. They assert that production code routes through the seam record, which the ported cases cannot prove on their own. The testkit contract tests in test/testkit/testkit.contract.test.ts are target-only for the same reason and are listed separately there.

approved_non_running.reason: Target-only. These are the worked examples of the skip and xfail mapping rules (docs/test-translation-conventions.md). Three of the eight dangerous translation patterns -- strict/non-strict xfail, skip semantics, and a caplog-equivalent sink -- have no source case anywhere in interlock control_plane (the suite has one xfail, in messagebus, and no caplog at all), so the rules are demonstrated here rather than by inventing a source node id that does not exist. They translate no source case and are not counted as ported coverage.

entries.reason: Accepted message-text deviation (D-0015, D-0017 rule 5). The asserted substring "not valid UTF-8" is emitted identically. The parenthetical inside that message interpolates the decoder's own wording, which differs from Python's ("'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xff in position 0: invalid start byte"); the port emits Node's TextDecoder wording rather than fabricating Python's. No assertion depends on the parenthetical.

entries.reason: In Python bool is an int, so True would store 1 -- a 1970 timestamp the typeof CHECK cannot catch. TypeScript rejects a boolean at compile time, so the value reaches the guard through a cast. The runtime guard is still exercised and still required, because untyped JavaScript callers pass exactly this value.

test/control_plane/migrator.test.ts::a caller's open transaction > migrating a connection with an open transaction is refused
entries.reason: Python sqlite3 opens a transaction implicitly before DML and commits it when isolation_level is set to None; better-sqlite3 has neither, so the specific hazard cannot exist. The transaction is opened explicitly and the property -- refused, and the caller work still uncommitted -- is asserted unchanged.
